about.heading: About the Committee
paragraphs: Nayer Pally Sealdah Sarbojanin Durga Puja Committee — organised by Jatio Yuba Sangha — is one of the older Durga Pujas of central Kolkata, founded in 1948. {year} marks our {anniversary}th year of celebration at Shraddhananda Park, Raja Rammohan Sarani, Sealdah.

Across nearly eight decades, the puja has weathered its share of hurdles — yet it has stood tall every single year, carried forward by the same spirit of community service, culture and togetherness it was founded on.
Every year, the pandal, the pratima, and the days of celebration are made possible by the generosity of sponsors, the effort of volunteers, and the warmth of everyone who walks through our gates.

events.title: Rath Yatra & Khuti Puja
events.blurb: A community favourite held annually at Shraddhananda Park, drawing crowds from across Sealdah for the chariot procession. Every year, Khuti Puja — marking the ceremonial start of pandal construction — is performed on this same day.

events.title: Cultural Nights
events.blurb: Music, dance and performances by local talent through the puja evenings, open to the whole neighbourhood. Line-up announced closer to the festival.

events.title: Bhog & Community Meals
events.blurb: Shared meals prepared and served to the community across the puja days, a tradition of seva at the heart of our celebration.

visitors.heading: Durga Puja, Open to the World
visitors.body: We warmly welcome tourists and visitors from abroad to experience Durga Puja with us — the rituals, the drums, the pandal, and the spirit of the neighbourhood. From Shashthi onward, our international guests are offered a special Bhog of Maa Durga, along with a friendly introduction to each day's customs. Guests from abroad may also offer Anjali to Maa Durga with the committee's guidance — a simple, heartfelt way to take part in the worship.

testimonials.heading: What Visitors Say
testimonials.intro: Words from devotees, neighbours and guests who have celebrated with us.

items.quote: A non-negotiable spot on our mandatory Pujo itinerary every single year.

intro: For those of us flying back to Kolkata from the Middle East for Durga Pujo, the city’s festive energy is electric, but navigation can sometimes feel overwhelming. That is precisely why Nayer Pally Durga Puja in Sealdah has earned a non-negotiable spot on our mandatory Pujo itinerary every single year.
What makes Nayer Pally truly special is how seamlessly it blends high-caliber festive artistry with effortless accessibility.

points.label: Thoughtful Theme Artistry
points.text: Year after year, the organizers craft deeply creative, visually stunning themes that captivate you the moment you step into the venue. The attention to detail and artistic execution never fail to leave an impression.

points.label: Flawless Crowd Management
points.text: Navigating Pujo crowds with family can be daunting, but Nayer Pally shines when it comes to visitor comfort. The layout and movement are exceptionally well managed, allowing you to absorb the beauty of the pandal and the Pratima without feeling rushed or overwhelmed.

points.label: A Feast for Kolkata Street Food Lovers
points.text: Right around the pandal, the food stalls serve up the ultimate Kolkata street food experience. Their wok-tossed Kolkata-style noodles and smoky, succulent kebabs are absolute standouts—flavor-packed, nostalgic, and worth the trip alone.

points.label: Family-Friendly Vibes
points.text: Tucked right behind the main pandal is a dedicated play area for kids—a rare and thoughtful addition that makes the location an absolute joy for families traveling with young children.

closing: Nayer Pally isn’t just another pandal stop; it embodies the true spirit of Kolkata’s hospitality—vibrant, organized, delicious, and welcoming to everyone returning home for the festival.

items.name: Bikram

items.quote: A Pujo Celebration Close to Our Hearts ❤️🙏

intro: Durga Pujo is not just a festival; it’s an emotion that brings families, traditions and generations together. Certainly brings me from Bangalore every year.

Celebrating Pujo at Nayer Pally Sealdah Sarbojanin Durga Puja was a beautiful experience. The magnificent Maa Durga pratima, vibrant festive atmosphere and warmth of the community lead by my adorable friend come sister Monalisa Banerjee truly captured the essence of Kolkata’s Durga Pujo.

With a legacy dating back to 1948, this Pujo continues to celebrate tradition, culture and togetherness. Experiencing it with my family and watching our little daughter discover the magic of Pujo made the occasion even more special.
Heartfelt appreciation to the entire organising committee and volunteers for keeping the spirit of our beloved festival alive.
Some celebrations become memories, but some become a part of your heart. This Pujo was certainly one of them.
